goal: Only open Amazon Turkey affiliate discovery after model-specific load evidence and low-risk plug-in use are verified.
allowedClasses: plug-in energy meter / wattmeter for verified low-risk plug loads
energy-monitoring smart plug for verified low-risk plug loads
blockedClassesAndScenarios: motor or compressor loads in consumer affiliate flow
damaged or overheating outlet, plug or device
unattended remote switching of resistive heating loads
unknown model-specific long-duration load rule when daily use is long
noBuyRule: If an owned product is technically compatible with the stated goal and safety evidence is complete, show no-purchase before any affiliate route.
energyCostRule: TRY cost is calculated only from the unit energy price entered by the user; ALO186 does not publish or infer a live tariff in this module.
